caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a high backrest composed of six vertical rectangular panels, each framed by thin borders and showing wood grain texture in varying patterns. The color of the wood is a medium reddish-brown throughout the bench, with some darker and lighter areas that indicate natural variations in the wood grain. The armrests are simple and extend slightly outward, with a gentle curvature. The seat is solid and flat, colored in a slightly darker shade of brown than the backrest, and it extends across the entire width of the bench. The legs are straight, supporting each corner of the bench. There is a visible horizontal support beam underneath the seat, painted in a dark brown or black color. The background is plain and light beige, providing contrast to the bench. The lower right corner of the image contains the signature “M. Eisman.”
title: Settee
